evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet

observations.why: Unhedged imperative issued by the account holder directing the system's knowledge; authority rests on the speaker's standing as submitter, not on argument or rapport.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes

observations.why: Second unhedged directive from the same speaker repeating the erasure command; authority is positional, not argued.
